task_title: Dogfood walk: node-create cannot distinguish a typo'd harness from a documented-but-unmeasured one
task_criteria: The dogfood lane's walk of README.md Quick start on a clean HOME filed three net-new rows on origin/main at 8df6b38 with a committed transcript, docs/audits/code-factory-dogfood-2026-11-03-20-47-54.probe.txt. For CF-125 (the row this task is named for): the transcript's section 6 must show both commands and both outputs ('--harness codex' and '--harness not-a-harness') producing the same 'FAIL staged_set — missing scripts/harness/install-<name>.sh' shape, and the row's premise must be visible in the tree at scripts/node-create.sh lines 20-22, where the staged set is built as harness/install-$HARNESS.sh with no validation of the harness name against specs/HARNESS.md's adapter table. CF-126 and CF-127 ride the same committed artifact (sections 7b and 7a).
